# Snapshot: gob.pe — MINSA news

**Source:** https://www.gob.pe/institucion/minsa/noticias
**Captured:** 2026-09-04

A frozen copy of a real page, kept so the harness has something to test that
nobody here designed. Held for testing only, not redistributed as content.

It is the DOM the browser built, not the HTML the server sent — the naming gaps
on a modern site live in what JavaScript injected, and a static fetch of this
page contains none of them. Stylesheets are downloaded rather than dropped,
because deleting them un-hides whatever the page hides with CSS and a snapshot
that alters visibility measures a page nobody visits.

Verified identical to the live page (2 `label` violations) and fully offline:
loading it makes zero external requests.

To refresh it, or to add another page, see [../../README.md](../../README.md).
